{{Quotation|game|Once called the Eastbury Reserve, this stretch of coastal land was renamed after the last [[The Guild Wars|Guild War]]. Its namesake, [[Saul D'Alessio]], was the founder of the [[White Mantle]] and is thought by many to be the savior of [[Kryta]].}}

The [[D'Alessio Seaboard (outpost)|D'Alessio Seaboard]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]] and home to the [[Temple of Tolerance]]. It is constantly assaulted by the [[Orr]]ian [[undead]].

==Getting There==
*Head west from [[Lion's Arch]], through the [[North Kryta Province]].
*The quest [[Report to the White Mantle]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[D'Alessio Seaboard]]
**This mission is the eighth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second in the [[Kryta]] region.

==Notes==
*Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title.
*Until the [[Feedback:Game updates/20111117|November 17th 2011]] update, it was possible to get experience from the first wave of Grasping Ghoul deaths, which allowed a way to gain progress towards [[Survivor]] without fighting.
